items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: Is that right, Ruth? Right. Right.

ctx.x: Tell them about the bankers, we call them bunkers them days.

The music we're playing now in these places, like on the street and everything, it's hardly much pleasure for the musicians or the people that are being entertained because it's constant. Of course they have to do it in modern times, you know what I mean, to turn it over and entertain the tourists and whatnot. During the time these gentlemen were talking about that, we'd be out there and play about in the whole hour. We didn't play no more than about five or six tunes. Is that right, Ruth? Right. Right. And the…
I ain't going to do nothing.
